subject.title: Add per-agent sandbox session visibility override feature

question: Should OpenClaw land this sandbox-only per-agent `sessionToolsVisibility` override independently, or fold it into the broader per-agent session visibility and A2A policy work at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/59170?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but it makes an existing per-agent sandbox config broaden runtime session access and overlaps another open authorization/config design, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent security boundary.

options.title: Land the sandbox-only layer
options.body: Accept this narrow override as the intended behavior for the existing sandbox key, with the broader per-agent session/A2A policy remaining separate.

options.title: Fold into broader policy work
options.body: Pause this branch and consolidate sandbox, session visibility, and A2A semantics under the broader per-agent policy PR or a replacement.

options.title: Require more upgrade proof first
options.body: Keep the branch shape but ask for explicit fresh-install and upgrade notes covering existing configs that already contain the per-agent sandbox key.

recommendation.title: Land the sandbox-only layer
recommendation.body: Accept this narrow override as the intended behavior for the existing sandbox key, with the broader per-agent session/A2A policy remaining separate.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent history is closest to the session authorization, sandbox clamp, and per-agent config policy boundary being decided here.
